891-8095-8207.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2829-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

277-2034-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2034-2577-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-1483-6972--112.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-1483-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

907-5226-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

2107-3457-7791.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Sunastian Falconer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

2033-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4986-5231-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
4986-5231-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

423-1437-5233-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-5233-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3941-4067-6281-7327.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

2034-2374-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

147-2438-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5231-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5231-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

944-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

914-3036-5223.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-5223.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2523-4365-4989.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2523-4365-4989.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Duke Ulder Ravengard triggers, giving Mondrak haste and myriad until end of turn.
Declare Mondrak as an attacker.
Mondrak's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Mondrak that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Mondrak tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondrak tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

2038-3129-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2713-4790-4891.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Atsushi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose Atsushi's first mode.

1283-2825-3298-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Goblins.
1283-2825-3298-3525.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brightstone Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brightstone Ritual, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

648-5256.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Fractal, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Fractal's power.

841-2034-3585-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2034-3585-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Badger token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Badger, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

1124-2156-2696-4074.description:
Activate Chandra, Hope's Beacon's second ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Chandra, Bold Pyromancer's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R} and dealing 2 damage to a player.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

88-202-779-2894.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
88-202-779-2894.description:
Attempt to draw a card.
The card draw is replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you instead to discard Dakmor Salvage, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Skola Grovedancer triggers, attempting to cause you to draw a card due to Lich.
Repeat from step 2.

124-1346-2501-2539.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
124-1346-2501-2539.description:
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater.
Repeated Reverberation's casualty ability triggers, creating two copies of it due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Repeated Reverberation, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast six times.
Cast Vraska's Fall by paying {2}{B}.
Each Repeated Reverberation triggers, copying Vraska's Fall a total of nine times due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Vraska's Fall, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters and sacrifice ten creatures and/or planeswalkers.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

413-1480-3000-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Squirrel Mob.
You control at least one additional creature.
413-1480-3000-3828.description:
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Squirrel Mob.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enter the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens and Blasting Station triggers.
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.

1661-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mortuary triggers, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2018-4053-4809.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-4053-4809.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
